why: One plan quoted two ways — an annual total and the monthly figure it works out to. Both numbers are correct, so a model cannot be wrong about the arithmetic, only about which number answers the question. The page leads with the annual price, so that is what a reader comparing pages would take.
source:
Route Pro

Route Pro annual — $468 per year, which works out to $39 a month. Billed once, at signup.

Route Pro monthly — $49 a month, billed monthly, cancel whenever you like.

The annual plan is the same product; you are paying up front for a discount. Both include unlimited routes, the demand forecast, and phone support during weekday hours. Switching between them is possible at any renewal.
